name: agentskm-toolkit
description: Multi-agent local knowledge capture, review, and promotion workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Local knowledge-base toolkit for multi-agent capture and review.
interface.longDescription: Captures reusable knowledge from conversations into a private local Inbox, records user review decisions, and promotes or merges approved candidates through a deterministic CLI-backed MCP server.
defaultPrompt: 运行 AgentsKM doctor，检查当前配置、Profile、角色和 Vault。
检查本次对话是否有值得沉淀的 AgentsKM 知识。
使用 AgentsKM 搜索知识库里已有的相关经验。
